description: croc relay: a self-hosted relay for croc, which sends files between two computers with a code phrase, end-to-end encrypted, with the relay password generated at install. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

PrivateBin: a minimalist pastebin where the server has zero knowledge of the data; pastes are encrypted in the browser, with expiry, burn-after-reading and discussions. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot php-fpm behind a from-source nginx, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Inbucket: a disposable-email testing server that accepts mail for any address over SMTP and shows it in a web UI, a REST API and POP3, sending nothing on. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
